svg.title: Three dataflows: which operand stays put, and which streams
svg.desc: Three 4 by 4 processing-element grids. In each, one operand type stays resident in every PE while the other two stream through; a PE fires when the operands it needs arrive together.

text.tspan: Weights stay in the PEs; inputs flow through
and partial sums gather as they move down.
Suits stage 1, whose weights are static.
Each output stays put while inputs and weights
both stream past it until the sum completes.
No partial-sum traffic until the very end.
Inputs stay in the PEs; weights flow through
and partial sums gather as they move down.
Suits an input matrix that is reused heavily.

g.text: large mark = held in the PE · small mark = streaming · shaded PE = firing

svg.text: Source: schematic · SCALE-Sim 3.0.0 implements exactly these three dataflows (no row-stationary mode)
